title: Table of every H1 and H2 string on the home, pricing and solutions pages with a kept or rewritten verdict
description: The home page has nine H1s ('Built for Bootcamps and Learning Communities', 'Everything you need for Modern Learning', 'Why Educators Choose Zedu', 'Got a Question? We Have an Answer' and others). 'Got a Question? We Have an Answer' is also an H1 on /pricing and /products/buzz. Deliver a table for /, /pricing, /solutions/schools, /solutions/bootcamps and /solutions/universities: exact heading text copied from the live HTML, current level, a one-line verdict (describes the page / slogan / repeated from another page) and replacement wording that only states what the page already covers. Keep each replacement under 60 characters. No claims the product pages do not already make.

goal.title: Give every zedu.chat marketing page one H1 and a clean heading order, by Fri 20 Nov
goal.description:
Checked on 22 Oct 2026 by counting H1 tags in each page's HTML: home 9, pricing 4, about 5, download 3, solutions 0. A page should have one H1 that says what the page is about.

Success looks like: each public marketing page has exactly one H1, section headings below it use H2 and H3 in order, nothing is skipped, and the visible design doesn't change. Verify by fetching each page and counting headings, and list for each page which element became which level and the zedu-fe file where it changed.

workstream.title: Check the words in the headings, not only their level, because a slogan is not a page description
workstream.description: A page can have exactly one H1 and still fail the intent: "Everything your cohort needs" tells a screen-reader user nothing about the page. Work: for every public route, record the H1 text and judge it as a description of the page in one line; flag headings that are slogans, that duplicate the site name, or that name a feature the page does not cover. Deliver the table of heading text with a kept or rewritten verdict and the replacement wording, ready to apply with the level fixes rather than in a second pass.
